AnthropicBeta.description:
Beta names you can send in the `anthropic-beta` header.

See [Beta headers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers) for how to send them and where to find the name a feature needs.

BetaManagedAgentsMemoryVersion.description:
One entry in a memory's history, recording a single change and who made it.

Every change to a memory adds one version. Only redaction can change a version after that. Versions belong to the memory store and stay after the memory is deleted. Each version is retained for at least the version retention period after it was written, unless the store itself is deleted.

Retrieving a redacted version succeeds, with `content`, `path`, `content_size_bytes`, and `content_sha256` set to `null`. Check `redacted_at` to find out whether a version was redacted.

See the [memory guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/memory#audit-memory-changes) to learn more about memory versions.

content.description: The memory's UTF-8 text content as of this version. `null` when `view=basic`, when `operation` is `deleted`, or when `redacted_at` is set.

content_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of `content` as of this version (64 characters). `null` when `redacted_at` is set or `operation` is `deleted`. Populated regardless of `view` otherwise.

content_size_bytes.description: Size of `content` in bytes as of this version. `null` when `redacted_at` is set or `operation` is `deleted`. Populated regardless of `view` otherwise.

created_at.description: When this version was written, in RFC 3339 format.

created_by.description:
Who made this change to the memory, or `null` if the author wasn't recorded.

Redacting the version doesn't change this field. A `session_actor` here is an agent that wrote through the store's mounted filesystem at `/mnt/memory/`. The version doesn't record the API key that created that session. So the author in `created_by` is who made the change, not who is ultimately responsible for it.

You can [retrieve the session](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions/retrieve) to learn more about where the change came from.

id.description: Unique identifier for this version (a `memver_...` value).

memory_id.description:
The ID of the memory that this version belongs to (`mem_...`).

The ID stays valid after the memory is deleted. Pass it as `memory_id` to [List Memory Versions](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/memory_stores/memory_versions/list) to get the memory's retained versions, including its `deleted` version while the lineage is retained.

memory_store_id.description: ID of the memory store this version belongs to (a `memstore_...` value).

operation.description: The kind of mutation this version records: `created`, `modified`, or `deleted`.

path.description: The memory's path at the time of this write. `null` if and only if `redacted_at` is set.

redacted_at.description:
When the version was redacted, in RFC 3339, or `null` if it hasn't been.

When set, `content`, `path`, `content_size_bytes`, and `content_sha256` are `null`.

See the [memory guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/memory#redact-a-version) to learn more about redaction.

redacted_by.description: Who redacted this version, or `null` if it has not been redacted. In practice always an `api_actor`, `user_actor`, or `service_account_actor` (agents do not have a redact capability).

BetaManagedAgentsActor.description: Identifies who performed an operation. Recorded when the operation happens and not updated afterwards, so the ID may refer to a user, service account, API key, or session that has since been deleted.

BetaManagedAgentsMemoryVersionOperation.description:
The kind of change that a memory version records.

Every change to a memory adds one version. If you update a memory and nothing changes, the memory doesn't get a new version.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionActor.description: An agent acting during a session, for example through the session's mounted filesystem. It names the session itself, not the user or API key that started the session.

session_id.description: ID of the session (a `sesn_...` value). Look up the session via [Retrieve a session](/en/api/beta/sessions/retrieve) for further provenance.

BetaManagedAgentsApiActor.description: A direct caller of the public API, identified by the API key that authenticated the request.

api_key_id.description: ID of the API key (an `apikey_...` value). This identifies the key, not the secret.

BetaManagedAgentsUserActor.description: A human user, for example acting through the Anthropic Console.

BetaManagedAgentsServiceAccountActor.description: A workload authenticated as a service account, for example via Workload Identity Federation.

service_account_id.description: ID of the service account (a `svac_...` value).

BetaManagedAgentsMemoryPreconditionFaile.description:
The error returned with HTTP status 409 when a request's precondition doesn't hold for the memory's current state, such as `precondition` on an update or `expected_content_sha256` on a delete.

The error doesn't include the memory's current state. Retrieve the memory to see its current content and `content_sha256` before you retry.

See the [memory guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/memory#safe-content-edits-optimistic-concurrency) to learn more about safe content edits with content hash preconditions.

BetaManagedAgentsMemoryPathConflictError.description:
The error returned with HTTP status 409 when you create or rename a memory and the path you give is already used by another memory or overlaps another memory's path.

Two paths overlap when one is an ancestor of the other, such as `/notes` and `/notes/todo.md`. To free the path, rename or delete the memory that `conflicting_memory_id` references, then retry. To change that memory instead of creating a new one, update it.

To handle the error in code, use `conflicting_path` and `conflicting_memory_id` instead of `message`.

conflicting_memory_id.description:
The ID of the memory that blocked the write (`mem_...`), or an empty string if that memory can't be identified.

Retry the request when it is empty.

conflicting_path.description: The path that blocked the write: the requested path, or the path of a memory that is an ancestor or descendant of it.
